headline: The Homebody demo names a room
lede: The attract run now furnishes a wing: once the cottage is paid, Pip's jar keeps pouring into a surplus, and that surplus buys the wing one radio. The room names itself at the doorstep, the playroom badge hangs there through the win — and its ink is now tuned to read at phone size, not just on the painter's canvas.

notes.text: #2752: the jar's surplus clause — once both kits stand, the refill that has nothing left to fund buys the wing ONE radio. Jar-paid, till byte-still, once per run, derived from what stands: seeds 7/1234/20261023 fire d3h7.0 before the win, 42/99 stay honestly silent. Five new peoplecheck gates; the jar-deduction mutant reddens exactly the economy gate.

The live 390-px leg caught what every node pin missed: the shipped badge ramp painted zero readable ink on a phone. The art moved — track 0.72 alpha, 3px — and now the gold glyph (27px) and ramp track (8px) both survive the blur.

A reaped session finished itself: its child processes committed, pushed and opened PR #2765 inside the slot's worktree after the parent was killed (#2758 corroborated with full detail). The lane re-verified the exact tip, killed the leftovers, and the ship landed with every gate proven twice.
